summary: Telecommunication Engineering graduate with hands-on experience in network troubleshooting, MikroTik configuration, VSAT operations, LAN/WLAN deployment, Linux administration, and IT technical support. Experienced in supporting VSAT field operations, antenna alignment and troubleshooting, basic RF signal analysis, network device configuration, and small-office IT infrastructure. Practical exposure to MikroTik RouterOS, Huawei networking devices, Ubuntu Linux, Wireshark, Nmap, VMware, and network security fundamentals. Seeking opportunities in Network Operations Center (NOC), Network Support, Junior Network Engineering, or IT roles.

responsibilities: Managed daily operational and technical support activities for a retail food outlet, including inventory, operational reporting, equipment, and basic IT infrastructure.
Developed a Microsoft Excel based revenue calculation and reporting system that replaced manual calculations and improved the efficiency and accuracy of daily reporting for the business owner.
Installed and configured 6 TP-Link Tapo CCTV cameras across multiple outlets using Wi-Fi and PoE connectivity, including device onboarding and centralized monitoring.
Configured Huawei BE3 Wi-Fi 7 router for an office environment, including wireless settings, device whitelisting, and basic QoS/bandwidth management.
Performed first-level troubleshooting for cashier computers, printers, network connectivity, and other basic hardware/software issues.
Assisted senior technicians in the installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of UBIQU VSAT systems at field sites.
Performed antenna alignment checks including polarization, azimuth, and elevation according to site requirements before proceeding with signal verification.
Performed VSAT modem/IP configuration using predefined templates and operational SOPs, including basic IP addressing, subnet, gateway, routing, VLAN, NAT, and QoS configurations.
Supported troubleshooting by checking operating frequency and SNR, with approximately >8 dB used as a reference under clear-weather conditions based on operational procedures.
Assisted in updating the LNA replacement procedure and work schedule under mentor supervision, helping simplify the maintenance workflow.
Assisted senior technicians in deploying internet and LAN infrastructure for a new commercial office environment. Supported installation and placement of ONT, modem, router, and network switches.
Assisted in configuring MikroTik RouterBoard and Huawei EchoLife HG8145V5 equipment.
Performed RJ45 cable termination and single-mode fiber optic splicing.
Conducted basic network testing using Wireshark and Nmap to verify connectivity.

education.degree: Vocational High School Major in Computer and Network Engineering (TKJ)

projects.title: Linux VPS & Network Administration
projects.description: Deployed and administered an Ubuntu-based VPS for remote system and networking practice. Configured SSH remote access, Linux users, packages, firewall rules, and basic server services and used Ngrok for temporary external access without directly exposing VPS ports to the public. Practiced web server deployment and Linux command-line administration.

projects.title: MikroTik Network Homelab
projects.description: Built a small-office network simulation using a physical MikroTik RB750R2 hEX Lite router. Configured IP address, DHCP, NAT, firewall rules, static routing, VLANs, QoS, and basic wireless settings. Practiced network troubleshooting, subnetting, and connectivity verification through a segmented LAN environment.
